# 1,400.00 CAD of consulting income into the Canadian bank, and 280.00 CAD of
# travel paid from it, each with a guid of its own, so that an edit with
# `--strategy update` can turn them into US dollar transactions:
#
# - ..._income_edited_into_a.txt pays the income into A, which owes 500.00;
# - a_usd_card_overpaid_then_its_travel_edited_onto_it.txt charges the travel
#   to a card holding a credit.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "Consulting income"
	guid: "0c0c0000000000000000000000000001"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1400.00 CAD
	Income:Consulting -1400.00 CAD

2034-02-01 * "Travel"
	guid: "0c0c0000000000000000000000000002"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"

	Assets:CAD Bank -280.00 CAD
